Who are we? We are Mallesons. The top-tier independent firm from Australia, a full-service firm trusted on the most complex and consequential matters across our region and around the world. With deep expertise, collective judgment and genuine collaboration, we cut through complexity so our clients can move forward with confidence and make more happen. Mallesons offers the latest technology; opportunities for ongoing learning; along with security and stability. This varied service desk position requires a calm and knowledgeable demeanour, underpinned by a customer centric approach. (iPhones etc.) - Active directory skills - ability to maintain, create, and delete user accounts Understanding of network topology Experience maintaining accurate IT asset records and performing laptop reimaging.
